prompts.hero:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: website hero illustration
Create a finished RepoSetup website illustration asset. RepoSetup is an open-source terminal-first development stack composer and installer. The supplied logo is a visual style reference only; do not reproduce the wordmark. Use its rounded angular stacked layers and terminal >_ motif to establish a coherent family. Restrained monochrome charcoal, graphite and soft ivory. Crisp polished geometric illustration with subtle isometric depth, no photorealism, no gradients or glow, no decorative noise. Strong silhouettes, intentional negative space, consistent corner radii. No written labels or words, no third-party logos, no watermark. This is a standalone reusable image asset, not a webpage or mockup.
Subject: An elegant exploded stack of three broad rounded diamond-shaped modules suspended above a flat base, connected by clean thin vertical alignment lines. The upper module is an ivory terminal tile with a large crisp charcoal >_ symbol. Below it, a graphite module and a charcoal module evoke composed development tools. Three small neutral component tiles approach the stack from the sides along precise routing lines, suggesting many tools assembled into one coherent stack. A grounded, carefully balanced arrangement; architectural clarity, not science fiction.
Composition: landscape 3:2, central composition with generous padding, all objects visible. Genuine transparent background. Simple matte surfaces, controlled hard-edge shading, visually refined and useful next to a website headline. No headline, no labels, no UI chrome.
